entities.name: Cho-Akhan
entities.description: A Cho-Arrim herbalist of the Rushwood on Mercadia who wielded the Ancestral Mask.

entities.name: Sia-am-Erh
entities.description: An ancient shaman whose tomb held the Ancestral Mask.

entities.name: Ancestral Mask
entities.description: A mask worn by Sia-am-Erh that took control of 'Akhan and bonded her to the dead Cho-Arrim.

entities.name: Rushwood
entities.description: Forest on Mercadia where 'Akhan's village lay.

events.summary: 'Akhan finds the tomb of Sia-am-Erh and the Ancestral Mask while seeking herbs.
events.quote: 'Akhan happened upon the ancient tomb of the shaman Sia-am-Erh

events.summary: After plague from Mercadia City kills her brother, 'Akhan decides to wield the mask to protect her village.
events.quote: she decided to wield the Ancestral Mask to protect her village and conquer the plaguebearers from the city.

events.summary: The mask takes control of 'Akhan and plunges her into the River, where she bonds with the dead Cho-Arrim.
events.quote: The Ancestral Mask took control of 'Akhan's body and plummeted her into the River

events.summary: 'Akhan and her two mothers prepare for war with Mercadia City.
events.quote: 'Akhan and her two mothers, Cho-Shadi and Cho-Fihad , prepared for war with Mercadia City.

relations.quote: her brother Cho-Ran died from the sickness
'Akhan and her two mothers, Cho-Shadi and Cho-Fihad

relations.note: She prepared for war with it.
relations.quote: prepared for war with Mercadia City.
